NADIA BRENNAN-AZIZ
Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps | Senior Platform and SRE Engineer
Manchester, UK | nadia.brennanaziz@example.com | +44 7700 900909 | github.com/nba-sre-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior SRE and platform engineer with 10 years in infrastructure, including the last 6 running Kubernetes platforms on AWS. Experienced in cloud infrastructure design and operation, Terraform, platform reliability, observability, and leading technical work across engineering teams. Builds self-service infrastructure and sensible paved roads that help product teams ship and operate services reliably.

CORE SKILLS
Cloud: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudFront, Spot)
Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Atlantis, Crossplane
Containers and delivery: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, GitHub Actions
Reliability and observability: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, PagerDuty
Systems and automation: Linux, Puppet, Go, Python, Bash, k6
Technical leadership: Technical leadership, cross-team collaboration, mentoring, incident command

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Platform Engineer — Tallybrook Ltd, Manchester / remote | Apr 2022–Present
- Tech lead of a five-person platform team, operating an AWS EKS platform with 8 clusters, approximately 350 services, and 3 regions.
- Built an internal developer platform with Go and Python service templates, Argo CD GitOps, and Crossplane self-service for RDS, SQS, and S3; adopted by all 14 product teams and reduced time from a new service to production from approximately 2 weeks to under 1 day.
- Introduced SLOs, burn-rate alerts, and error budgets for the 20 most critical services; agreed the error-budget policy with product leadership and reduced on-call pages per week by approximately 60%.
- Led migration from cluster-autoscaler managed node groups to Karpenter, using Spot instances for stateless workloads with interruption handling; reduced EC2 spend by 38%, approximately GBP 410,000 per year.
- Participate in the incident commander rotation and wrote the incident and post-mortem process.
- Mentored 3 engineers moving from backend engineering into SRE.

Site Reliability Engineer — Brightwater Games, Leeds | Jan 2019–Mar 2022
- Operated AWS game-backend infrastructure (EC2, ECS, then EKS) for titles with up to 1.2 million daily active players.
- Managed AWS infrastructure as code using approximately 40 Terraform modules, with Atlantis plan/apply workflows on pull requests.
- Replaced a noisy Nagios setup with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Loki.
- Ran k6 load tests and launch-day capacity planning, including tests simulating 300,000 concurrent players; identified and fixed a connection-pool limit before launch.

Linux Systems Engineer — Pennine Hosting, Sheffield | Jul 2016–Dec 2018
- Managed approximately 600 Linux servers for hosting customers using Puppet configuration management.
- Automated systems work with Bash and Python and provided on-call support for customer incidents.

SELECTED TECHNICAL CONTRIBUTIONS
- Speaker at a UK DevOps meetup in 2024: “SLOs that product managers care about”.
- Built an open-source Kubernetes cleanup controller in Go using controller-runtime to delete expired preview namespaces; approximately 120 GitHub stars.

EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science, University of the North Moors | 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) | 2021, renewed 2024
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional | 2023

LANGUAGES
English (native), Urdu (conversational)

Corvale’s work taking infrastructure for vehicle-to-cloud connectivity from architecture into production is a compelling application of my platform and reliability experience. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to a reliable, observable cloud platform for the new fleet.

Best wishes,
Nadia Brennan-Aziz
